title: Highly stable drone-shaped lanthanide clusters: structure, assembly mechanism, and crystalline–amorphous transitions

material_class.structural_family: drone-shaped Dy9 cluster with equatorial Dy8 plane, apical Dy, and μ4-Cl

synthesis.procedure: A mixture of 2-pyridinecarbohydrazide (0.2 mmol, 27.4 mg), 2,3,4-trihydroxybenzaldehyde (0.2 mmol, 30.8 mg), mixed-metal dysprosium salt Dy(NO3)3·6H2O:DyCl3·6H2O = 1:1 (about 0.25 mmol), and triethylamine (60 μL) was dissolved in mixed solvent CH3OH:CH3CN = 1:1 in a Pyrex tube. The tube was sealed and heated at 80 °C in an oven for 2 days (48 h) under solvothermal conditions, giving brown-red blocky crystals of cluster 1 in about 46% yield (based on Dy(NO3)3·6H2O).
synthesis.vessel_or_method: sealed Pyrex tube; solvothermal heating in an oven
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: brown-red blocky crystals observed after solvothermal reaction

properties.summary: Cluster 1 is a Dy9 SMM. DC susceptibility under 1000 Oe shows χmT = 115.79 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K (below 127.53 cm3 K mol−1 for nine free Dy(III) ions) decreasing to 55.86 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K. Magnetization at 2–5 K and 0–7 T reaches 28.97 Nβ at 2 K and 15 kOe; M vs H/T curves do not overlay. No obvious hysteresis at 2 K. Under zero DC field, χ″ is frequency- and temperature-dependent. Arrhenius fit gives Ueff = 35.69 K and τ0 = 6.57×10−9 s; a full-temperature multi-process fit gives Ueff = 52.4 K and τ0 = 2.24×10−10 s.

measurements.name: magnetization
measurements.conditions: 2 K, 15 kOe; M vs H measured 2–5 K, 0–7 T

measurements.conditions: zero DC field; τ = τ0 exp(Ueff/kBT)
